final: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '(blank or missing)') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS winner_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '(blank or missing)') ORDER BY hand
